scope: Coastal Bend (Nueces, San Patricio, Victoria, Kleberg) - healthcare, mental health, childcare, employment, legal

records.name: Nueces Center for Mental Health & Intellectual Disabilities (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.organization: Nueces Center for Mental Health & Intellectual Disabilities
records.description_en: The public mental health center for Nueces County. It offers crisis help, adult and youth mental health care, and services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Nueces County residents who need mental health, crisis, or disability services.
records.how_to_apply: In a crisis, call the 24-hour crisis line at (888) 767-4493. For other services, call the main number at (361) 886-6900.
records.notes: 24-hour crisis line: (888) 767-4493. The old bhcnc.org (Behavioral Health Center of Nueces County) address redirects to this site. Hours not listed on the site.

records.name: Coastal Plains Integrated Health - Kleberg-Kenedy County Clinic
records.organization: Coastal Plains Integrated Health (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Public mental health clinic in Kingsville. It offers adult and youth mental health care, substance use help, disability (IDD) services, veteran services, and 24/7 crisis help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people living in Coastal Plains' 9-county area, including Kleberg County.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Kingsville clinic at (361) 592-6481 or the toll-free line (888) 819-5312. In a crisis, call the 24/7 crisis hotline at (800) 841-6467.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.
records.cost: Fee schedule based on ability to pay (see provider fee schedule)
records.notes: 24/7 crisis hotline: (800) 841-6467. Youth Empowerment Services inquiry line: (800) 831-6467. Main office: 200 Marriott Drive, Portland, TX 78374, (361) 777-3991.

records.name: Coastal Plains Integrated Health - San Patricio County Clinic (Taft)
records.organization: Coastal Plains Integrated Health (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Public mental health clinic in Taft for San Patricio County. It offers mental health care, substance use help, disability (IDD) services, and 24/7 crisis help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people living in Coastal Plains' 9-county area, including San Patricio County.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Taft clinic at (361) 528-4516 or the toll-free line (888) 819-5312. In a crisis, call the 24/7 crisis hotline at (800) 841-6467.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m.
records.cost: Fee schedule based on ability to pay (see provider fee schedule)
records.notes: 24/7 crisis hotline: (800) 841-6467. Main location: 200 Marriott Drive, Portland, TX 78374 (San Patricio County), main phone (361) 777-3991.

records.name: Gulf Bend Center (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Public mental health center in Victoria. It offers adult and youth mental health care, substance use treatment, disability (IDD) services, veteran services, and 24-hour crisis help.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Calhoun, DeWitt, Goliad, Jackson, Refugio, Lavaca and Victoria counties.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 575-0611 or (800) 421-8825 for services. In a crisis, call the 24-hour line at (877) 723-3422.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8 am-5 pm; open until 7 pm the 1st Thursday (Victoria)
records.notes: 24-hour crisis line: (877) SAFEGBC / (877) 723-3422. Also serves Calhoun, DeWitt, Goliad, Jackson, Refugio and Lavaca counties.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend - Mission Plaza Career Center
records.description_en: Free job help center in Corpus Christi. Staff help with job searches, resumes, interview practice, career coaching, and training scholarships.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in the Coastal Bend area. You do not have to be unemployed to use services.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the career center or call (361) 882-7491. Staff can also help by phone, text, and email.
records.notes: Replaced the former Staples St. career center in May 2026. The board serves 11 counties including Nueces, San Patricio and Kleberg. Hours not listed on the site.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend - Kingsville Career Center
records.description_en: Free job help center in Kingsville on the Coastal Bend College campus. It helps with job searches, resumes, and job training.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in the Kingsville and Kleberg County area.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the career center or call (361) 592-1006.
records.address: 1814 S. Brahma Blvd. (Coastal Bend College Campus)
records.notes: Hours not listed on the site; call ahead.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend - Sinton Career Center
records.description_en: Free job help center in Sinton. It helps with job searches, resumes, and job training.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in the San Patricio County area.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the career center or call (361) 364-3284 or (800) 727-4356.
records.notes: Hours not listed on the site; call ahead.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Golden Crescent - Victoria Workforce Center
records.description_en: Free job help center in Victoria. It offers job search help, career exploration, wage information, and on-the-job training, with services for veterans, seniors, people with disabilities, and youth.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For job seekers in the Golden Crescent area, including Victoria County.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the center or call (361) 578-0341.
records.hours: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday
records.notes: Board office phone: (361) 576-5872. Relay TX: 711. Serves Gonzales, Lavaca, DeWitt, Jackson, Victoria, Goliad and Calhoun counties.

records.name: Child Care Financial Assistance - Workforce Solutions Coastal Bend
records.description_en: Helps low-income families pay for child care while parents work or go to school or training.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families in the 11-county Coastal Bend area with children under 13 (under 19 with a disability), income at or below 85% of State Median Income, and parents working or in school at least 25 hours a week (single parent) or 50 combined hours (two parents).
documents_needed: Child's birth certificate, current U.S. passport, or hospital/public health/church record
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas Child Care Connection portal at childcare.twc.texas.gov, or call (361) 885-3010 for help.
records.cost: Free or reduced cost; a parent share of cost may apply
records.notes: Income limit is 85% of State Median Income (not FPL). Family assets may not exceed $1 million. Children must be U.S. citizens or legal immigrants. A document checklist is on the provider site.

records.name: Child Care Assistance - Workforce Solutions Golden Crescent
records.description_en: Helps low-income families in the Golden Crescent area pay for child care while parents work, train, or go to school.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families with income at or below 85% of State Median Income where parents work at least 25 hours a week (single parent) or 50 hours (two parents). TANF families, teen parents, families with children with disabilities, and families experiencing homelessness may also qualify.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 576-5872 or visit 1905 Leary Lane in Victoria. Enrollment forms are on the website.
records.cost: Sliding fee (parent share of cost based on income)
records.notes: Services are subject to a waiting list. Uses a 2026 sliding fee scale.

records.name: Head Start Birth to Five - Community Action Corporation of South Texas
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Free early learning and child care for young children from 6 weeks to 5 years old. Centers include Kingsville, Sinton, Mathis, Odem, Portland, Taft, Gregory, and Aransas Pass.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For children 6 weeks to 5 years old in families that meet federal poverty guidelines. Children in foster care, homeless families, and families on TANF, SNAP, or SSI get priority.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online using the Apply Now link on the program page, or call (361) 664-0145.
records.notes: Income rules may be waived for children with disabilities who have an IEP or IFSP. Main office: 204 E First St., Alice, TX 78333. Portland Head Start center: 518 Elm St, Portland, TX 78374 (per headstart.gov locator).

records.name: Upbring Head Start / Early Head Start - Corpus Christi
records.organization: Lutheran Social Service of the South, Inc. (Upbring)
records.description_en: Free Head Start preschool and Early Head Start care at many centers across Corpus Christi, such as Los Pequenos, Stepping Stone, Cliff Maus, and Navarro.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For young children in low-income families in Corpus Christi. Early Head Start serves infants and toddlers; Head Start serves preschoolers.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 237-3041 to register.
records.notes: Center examples from headstart.gov: Los Pequenos, 2801 Morris St (78405); Stepping Stone, 1625 Arlington Dr (78415); Cliff Maus, 1458 W Point Rd (78416). West Oso ISD Head Start (5350 Bear Ln) registers at (361) 806-5900.

records.name: Victoria County Head Start and Early Head Start
records.description_en: Free Head Start preschool and Early Head Start care in Victoria.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For young children in low-income families in Victoria County.
records.how_to_apply: Call (830) 331-8908 to register.
records.notes: Another Head Start preschool site: FW Gross Early Childhood Center, 1208 S Navarro St, Victoria, TX 77901.

records.name: Free School Meals (Community Eligibility Provision) - Victoria ISD
records.organization: Victoria Independent School District Child Nutrition
records.description_en: All Victoria ISD students in PreK through 12th grade get free breakfast and lunch at school for the 2026-2027 school year.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Any student enrolled at a Victoria ISD school. No meal application is needed.
records.how_to_apply: No application needed. Families are asked to fill out an Income Survey form online at visd.net.
records.notes: Covers school year 2026-2027 under CEP. VISD also runs a Summer Meal Program.

records.name: Nueces Aid Healthcare Access
records.description_en: Helps Nueces County residents with low income get health care at low or no cost.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Nueces County residents with household income at or below 150% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines and countable resources under $5,571.37.
documents_needed: Proof of income (pay stubs, tax returns, or benefit letters)
Proof of Nueces County residency (house payment receipt, rent receipt with lease, or utility bill with Statement of Residency form)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online, or get help at NCHD Enrollment Services, 600 Elizabeth St., Corpus Christi, or at a partner clinic. Call (361) 881-3000.
records.notes: Homestead, personal property and one vehicle are exempt from resources. Also enroll at Dr. Hector P. Garcia Memorial Family Health Center, 2606 Hospital Blvd. (361) 902-4855; CHRISTUS Trinity Clinic Robstown, 1038 Texas Yes Blvd (361) 861-9005; CHRISTUS Trinity Clinic Westside, 4617 Greenwood Rd (361) 814-8448. District line: (361) 808-3300.

records.name: San Patricio County Indigent Health Care Program
records.description_en: County program that helps very low-income San Patricio County residents pay for health care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: San Patricio County residents with income at or below 21% of the federal poverty guidelines and resources under $2,000.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the office to be screened. If you may qualify, you will get an application. A printable application is also online.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 am-5:00 pm (closed 12:00-1:00 pm)
records.notes: Staff give referrals to people who do not qualify. Monthly outreach sites in Mathis, Ingleside and Aransas Pass.

records.name: Kleberg County Indigent Health Care & Welfare
records.description_en: County office that handles indigent health care and welfare help for Kleberg County residents.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income Kleberg County residents. Call the office for income and resource rules.
records.how_to_apply: Call the indigent health care line at (361) 595-8569 or the welfare line at (361) 595-8555.
records.notes: Eligibility limits and hours are not posted on the county page. The page lists both 700 E. King and the Courthouse at 700 E Kleberg Ave.

records.name: Corpus Christi-Nueces County Public Health District
records.organization: Corpus Christi-Nueces County Public Health District
records.description_en: Public health office offering shots (immunizations), STI/HIV testing and prevention, tuberculosis services, and WIC.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Nueces County.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 826-7200 or visit the Horne Road office.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. (closed 12:00-1:00 p.m.)

records.name: WIC Clinic - Corpus Christi-Nueces County Public Health District
records.organization: Corpus Christi-Nueces County Public Health District
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food, nutrition help, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant, breastfeeding, or postpartum women and children under 5 who meet income rules. You automatically meet the income rule if you get Medicaid, TANF, or SNAP. You must live in Texas; U.S. citizenship is not required.
records.how_to_apply: Start online at texaswic.org/apply, call (361) 826-1355, or apply in person at the clinic.
records.hours: Monday-Thursday 8am-6pm (closed 12-1 pm); Friday 8 am-12 pm

records.name: Victoria County Public Health Department
records.description_en: Public health office offering shots (immunizations), STI testing, TB testing, HIV/AIDS resources, car seat checks, and home visiting programs for new parents.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Victoria County and nearby communities.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 578-6281 or visit the office.
records.hours: Monday through Thursday 8 am to noon, 1 pm to 5 pm (individual programs may vary)

records.name: Victoria County WIC Program
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food, nutrition help, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant, breastfeeding, or postpartum women, infants, and children under 5 who meet WIC income rules.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 578-2884 or (800) 880-9427 to make an appointment.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 8 am-noon, 12:30-5:30 pm; Fri 8 am-noon; 2nd and 4th Mondays 5:30-7 pm; 2nd and 4th Saturdays 8 am-noon
records.notes: Also runs WIC clinics in Cuero, Goliad, Port Lavaca, Yoakum and Yorktown.

records.name: San Patricio County WIC Program
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy food, nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and health referrals to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant, breastfeeding, and postpartum women, infants, and children who meet WIC income rules.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Texas WIC portal or find a clinic at find.texaswic.org. For questions, call the WIC office at (361) 587-3510.
records.notes: The phone listed is the WIC Director's line. Clinic addresses and hours are not on the county page; use find.texaswic.org.

records.name: Kleberg County City-County Health Unit
records.description_en: Local public health department for Kingsville and Kleberg County.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For residents of Kingsville and Kleberg County.
records.notes: County page does not list services or hours. Mailing address: P.O. Box 1458, 3421 North Farm Market 1355, Kingsville.

records.name: Amistad Health - Brownlee Main Clinic
records.description_en: Community health center with medical, dental, behavioral health, pediatric, and women's health care, plus a pharmacy. Uninsured patients pay on a sliding scale.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. Patients without insurance can get a lower price based on family size and income.
documents_needed: If uninsured: two forms of ID and proof of income (recent tax return or pay stubs)
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 884-2242 to make an appointment.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 8:00 AM-8:00 PM; Fri 8:00 AM-5:00 PM; Sat 9:00 AM-2:00 PM
records.notes: Federally qualified health center. Behavioral Health (361) 886-3065; Dental (361) 886-3000; Pediatrics (361) 886-3030; Women's Health (361) 299-7055; Pharmacy (361) 299-7080; Medication Assistance Program (361) 886-3014. Website available in English and Spanish.

records.name: Amistad Health - Free Benefits Application Help
records.description_en: A community health worker helps you apply for or renew SNAP, Medicaid, CHIP, Medicare Savings, Marketplace insurance, and Social Security. Televisits are available.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public.
records.how_to_apply: Schedule an appointment by calling (361) 336-2522 or (361) 442-4482.
records.hours: Monday & Tuesday: 9:00 AM-4:30 PM

records.name: Amistad Health - Robstown
records.description_en: Neighborhood community health clinic in Robstown. Uninsured patients pay on a sliding scale.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. Sliding fee discounts based on family size and income.
documents_needed: If uninsured: two forms of ID and proof of income (recent tax return or pay stubs)
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 886-3040 to make an appointment.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM-5:00 PM
records.notes: A second Robstown site, Amistad Health @Calderon, is at 710 E Main Ave, (361) 886-3020, Mon-Fri 8 AM-5 PM.

records.name: Amistad Health - Aransas Pass
records.description_en: Community health clinic in Aransas Pass (San Patricio County). Uninsured patients pay on a sliding scale.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone. Sliding fee discounts based on family size and income.
documents_needed: If uninsured: two forms of ID and proof of income (recent tax return or pay stubs)
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 886-3025 to make an appointment.
records.hours: Monday 8:00 AM-8:00 PM; Tue-Fri 8:00 AM-5:00 PM

records.name: Amistad Health - Pediatrics (Kids Clinic)
records.description_en: Children's clinic on the south side of Corpus Christi with evening and Saturday hours. Uninsured families pay on a sliding scale.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For children and teens. Sliding fee discounts based on family size and income.
documents_needed: If uninsured: two forms of ID and proof of income (recent tax return or pay stubs)
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 994-7255 to make an appointment.
records.hours: Mon-Thu 8:00 AM-9:00 PM; Fri 8:00 AM-5:00 PM; Sat 10:00 AM-2:00 PM

records.name: Community Action Health Center - Sinton
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Community health center in Sinton with family medical care, behavioral health, and a separate pediatric clinic. Fees are based on income.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, regardless of ability to pay. Accepts Medicaid, CHIP, Medicare, private insurance, and self-pay.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 364-4486 to make an appointment.
records.hours: Family: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM-12:00 PM, 1:00-5:00 PM; Behavioral: Mon & Fri 8:00 AM-12:00 PM, 1:00-5:00 PM
records.notes: Pediatric clinic: 1133 E. Sinton Street, Mon-Fri 8:00 AM-12:00 PM, 1:00-5:00 PM. Federally qualified health center.

records.name: Community Action Health Center - Mathis
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Community health center in Mathis with family, pediatric, and behavioral health care. Fees are based on income.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, regardless of ability to pay. Accepts Medicaid, CHIP, Medicare, private insurance, and self-pay.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 547-4121 to make an appointment.
records.hours: Family & Pediatric: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM-12:00 PM, 1:00-5:00 PM; Behavioral: Mon-Thu 8:00 AM-12:00 PM, 1:00-5:00 PM
records.notes: HRSA lists this as a school-based health center site.

records.name: Community Action Health Center - Kingsville
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Community health center in Kingsville with family, pediatric, dental, and behavioral health care. Fees are based on income.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to everyone, regardless of ability to pay. Accepts Medicaid, CHIP, Medicare, private insurance, and self-pay.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 592-3237 to make an appointment.
records.address: 1311 E. General Cavazos Blvd, Suite 303 & Suite C
records.hours: Family: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM-12:00 PM, 1:00-5:00 PM, 3rd Saturday 8:00 AM-12:00 PM; Pediatric: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM-5:00 PM; Behavioral: Mon-Thu 8:00 AM-12:00 PM, 1:00-5:00 PM
records.notes: Dental center is in Suite C (per HRSA data). HRSA also lists Javelina Health Clinic, 1210 N Retama St, Kingsville, (361) 239-0600.

records.name: Victoria Community Health Center
records.organization: Community Health Centers of South Central Texas, Inc.
records.description_en: Community health center in Victoria offering checkups, sick visits, dental, mental health, pediatrics, women's health, senior care, vaccines, and labs.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to all, regardless of age, income, or insurance status. Sliding fee scale and financial help are available.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 576-2110 to make an appointment.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8 AM-5 PM (Tuesday until 8 PM)
records.notes: Federally qualified health center. Spanish availability varies by provider.

records.name: Coastal Bend Wellness Foundation
records.description_en: Community health center in Corpus Christi offering primary care, HIV testing, prevention (PrEP/PEP) and treatment, women's health, counseling, substance use treatment, pharmacy, and LGBTQIA+ care.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to people in need in the Coastal Bend area.
records.notes: Listed in HRSA health center site data. Hours and fee policy not listed on the homepage.

records.name: CEAP Utility Assistance - San Patricio County (CACOST Sinton office)
records.organization: Community Action Corporation of South Texas (CACOST)
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric and gas bills through the Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP).
records.eligibility_summary_en: Households in San Patricio County with income at or below 150% of the federal poverty guidelines (for example, up to $23,940 a year for one person in 2026).

eligibility_rules.residency_required: San Patricio County (or other CACOST CEAP county)

documents_needed: Proof of citizenship or legal residency for each household member
30 days of consecutive pay stubs or 2025 award letters
Front and back copies of current utility bills with meter numbers
Declaration of income statement if self-employed or unemployed
records.how_to_apply: Request an appointment using the online form on the CEAP page, or call the Sinton office at (361) 364-0220. Sending a request does not guarantee an appointment.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 9 a.m.-12 p.m. and 1 p.m.-4 p.m.
records.notes: The Sinton office also serves Bee County. CACOST CEAP does not cover Nueces, Kleberg, or Victoria counties.

records.name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid - Corpus Christi Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people with problems like housing, family law, and public benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income residents of TRLA's service area, which includes Nueces County.
records.how_to_apply: Call the intake line at (956) 996-8752 or toll-free (833) 329-8752 to apply for free legal help.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm
records.notes: Courthouse office: 901 Leopard St., Room 105, Corpus Christi, TX 78401. TRLA serves 68 counties; the offices page confirmed Nueces, but San Patricio and Kleberg coverage should be confirmed when calling.

records.name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid - Victoria Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people with problems like housing, family law, and public benefits.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income residents of TRLA's service area, which includes Victoria County.
records.how_to_apply: Call the intake line at (956) 996-8752 or toll-free (833) 329-8752 to apply for free legal help.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8am-5pm

records.name: Coastal Bend Food Bank
records.description_en: Regional food bank that supplies food pantries in every Corpus Christi zip code and in nearby rural counties. Use the online agency locator to find a pantry near you.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who need food in Corpus Christi and the surrounding Coastal Bend.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Agency Locator on the website to find a pantry by zip code, or call (361) 887-6291.
records.notes: Serves Corpus Christi plus 11 rural counties (counties not named on the page; San Patricio and Kleberg coverage not confirmed). Food is given out through partner pantries.

records.name: Food Bank of the Golden Crescent
records.organization: Food Bank of the Golden Crescent
records.description_en: Regional food bank in Victoria that works with food pantries and food distributions across the Golden Crescent.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who need food in the Golden Crescent area, including Victoria County.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Food Pantry List or Food Pantry Map on the website, or call (361) 578-0591.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 am-4:30 pm (closed 12:00-1:00 pm)
records.notes: Serves 11 counties in the Golden Crescent region.

records.name: CCRTA Reduced Fare Program (B-ID Card)
records.description_en: Half-price bus fares in Corpus Christi: $0.50 per ride and $17.50 for a 31-day pass.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People with disabilities (including disabled veterans), Medicare card holders, and technical/vocational college students. Seniors can show a state ID showing age 65+.
documents_needed: Medicare card, Disabled Veteran ID, Medicaid card, or state ID showing age 65+
records.how_to_apply: Show a valid ID when you board, or download the B-ID application, bring it to the Customer Service Center, and pick up your card once approved.
records.notes: Reduced 31-day passes are sold only at the Customer Service Center. B-Line paratransit is also offered: https://www.ccrta.org/services/b-line

records.name: Corpus Christi Hope House
records.description_en: 24/7 emergency shelter and transitional housing for pregnant women, single mothers, and families, plus food, clothing, baby items, counseling, and parenting classes.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Families, pregnant women, and single mothers with children facing homelessness, addiction, domestic violence, poverty, or a crisis pregnancy in the Coastal Bend.
records.how_to_apply: Call (361) 852-2273 or visit the office.
records.hours: Office: Mon 8 AM-5 PM; Tue & Thu 9 AM-5 PM; Wed 9:30 AM-7 PM; Fri 8 AM-12 PM (closed 12-1 PM)
records.notes: Also offers homeless prevention services. Pregnant women without other children also qualify.

records.name: Mid-Coast Family Services
records.description_en: Help for survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault in Victoria, including a crisis center, a 24-hour hotline, and housing and rental assistance.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people facing family violence, sexual assault, or homelessness in the Victoria area.
records.how_to_apply: Call the hotline at (361) 573-4357 or (800) 870-0368. For other services, call (361) 575-7842.
records.notes: Domestic Violence & Sexual Assault Hotline: (361) 573-4357 or (800) 870-0368. Counties served are not listed on the homepage.
